metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code plugins - agents and skills for development workflows

plugins.description: Essential development agents, rules, and skills for everyday coding workflows
plugins.name: mz-dev-base

plugins.description: Full development pipeline — autonomous coding, reviewing, testing, debugging, auditing, optimizing, and polishing skills with TDD-grounded multi-agent orchestration
plugins.name: mz-dev-pipe

plugins.description: Research and content pipelines — multi-source web research, file translation with structural fidelity, prior-output synthesis, and codebase explanation with diagrams
plugins.name: mz-research-pipe

plugins.description: Git workflow review pipelines — branch-level deep review with multi-lens fan-out (bugs, security, architecture, performance, maintainability). Depends on mz-dev-pipe for cross-plugin web research dispatch.
plugins.name: mz-dev-git

plugins.description: Business outreach intelligence — /outreach-research discovers companies into `.mz/outreach/<run>/companies/`; /outreach-enrich-company fans out 5 specialist subagents to deepen the card and then drafts naturalized LinkedIn/email letters into it; /outreach-update-card logs dated interaction entries. Both writer skills relocate the card to `.mz/outreach/active/<YYYY-MM-DD>_<slug>.md` (last-interaction-date prefix)
plugins.name: mz-biz-outreach

plugins.description: Job and freelance hunt intelligence — /job-search and /freelance-search run full CV-to-listings pipelines for salaried roles and freelance gigs respectively; /job-recruiter-info does one-shot recruiter discovery; /freelance-pitch drafts a grounded proposal for one gig (≤350 words, milestones/pricing cited verbatim)
plugins.name: mz-job-outreach

plugins.description: Multi-perspective AI panels and creative writing tools — brainstorming, Delphi-style expert consultation, technical documentation, AI-text naturalization, and copywriting
plugins.name: mz-creative

plugins.description: Evidence-anchored character-voice code roasting — 7 personas deliver roasts grounded in real findings, never fabricated
plugins.name: mz-funny

plugins.description: Cross-session project memory — automatic knowledge persistence, injection, and compaction recovery
plugins.name: mz-memory

plugins.description: UI/UX design document generation — researches the domain, drafts a comprehensive spec, and iterates against ui/ux/art/accessibility critics with a WCAG hard gate
plugins.name: mz-design

plugins.description: Personal Obsidian knowledge base skills and agents — vault maintenance, note processing, review, link suggestions, and Obsidian syntax reference
plugins.name: mz-knowledge
